subject: Eval dataset & prompt-pack swap — MAP, limited access, and close cadence
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greencart.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@greencart.ai
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval assets exchange + MAP draft

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team at GreenCart is excited to get a short evaluation run with Redwood. We want to accelerate the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can validate latency and hallucination profiles against our customer transcripts.

High level asks from our side:
- Prompt pack (seed prompts + expected outputs) for retail checkout scenarios
- ~5k test cases (anonymized) and a small sample of real transcripts (PII redacted by us)
- Short-term sandbox access for 4 engineers (ephemeral credentials)

Can you share Redwood's MAP + proposed close schedule? We have procurement timelines and a legal review that need to align. Also flag any usage constraints on the dataset/prompt pack (retention windows, sharing restrictions).

If it's helpful I can loop in our engineering lead.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform, GreenCart Inc.
alex.torres@greencart.ai
+1 415-555-0123
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greencart.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange + MAP draft

Hi Alex — great to hear. Attaching an initial MAP and a sealed prompt pack sample for your review. The attached MAP (MAP_GreenCart_v1.1.pdf) lays out responsibilities, acceptance gates, and the proposed close cadence. A few callouts up front: 

- Access: Redwood grants ephemeral sandbox accounts (30-day tokens) for up to 4 engineers; we can extend on a per-request basis during the pilot window.
- Usage constraints: evaluation materials are provided under limited-use terms — no redistribution, no rehosting outside your test environment, and deletion upon close/expiration per the MAP.
- Retention: prompt packs and test cases must be retained only for the duration of the pilot + 14 days (unless we agree to extend).
- Metrics: acceptance criteria defined as latency P50 < 120ms, FNR<6% on named entity masking tests, and qualitative sanity checks on 200 seed prompts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your team reviews MAP_GreenCart_v1.1 and returns redlines by EOD Tue (Jun 2).
2) We provision sandbox creds and upload GC_eval_promptpack_v1.zip to the Drive link.
3) Run acceptance tests; we iterate fixes and close by Jun 13 if all gates pass.

Attachments included: MAP_GreenCart_v1.1.pdf (MAP), prompt pack sample (GC_eval_promptpack_v1.zip).

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0789
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greencart.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange + MAP draft

Alex / Mina — adding a couple of technical constraints so expectations are aligned: 

- Sandbox environment will run on a pre-provisioned cluster (t3g-equivalent CPU nodes with tokenized access). We do not provide GPU-backed instances for this short pilot unless the MAP converts to a paid pilot.
- Maximum daily token quota per tenant: 2M tokens; if you need a higher burst window we can open a temporary increase (requires signed MSA or purchase order).
- For the sample transcripts: we will accept hashed/anonymized payloads only. We will not accept raw PII.
- Audit logs: we can expose request/response telemetry for research purposes but audit retention is 30 days by default (can be extended under an enterprise contract).

I'll provision the sandbox after we receive the signed MAP or a clear redline set. For the acceptance tests, we'll provide a small harness (curl + node example) and an automated scorer for the 200 seed prompts so results are reproducible.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.inference
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greencart.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@greencart.ai, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange + MAP draft

Mina — thanks, this is very clear and granular which helps. A few quick items from our side: 

- Our legal team has two small redlines around the deletion clause and an assurance on the scope of telemetry access. I'll attach the redlines by EOD today.
- Procurement asked whether Redwood can accept a standard PO (we'll include that in the email to procurement). If we need DocuSign for the MAP we can do that instead.
- Can you confirm the process for an emergency takedown if we discover a prompt that exposes customer-identifying info? We need an SLA for takedowns during the pilot window.

If possible we'd like to start ingestion on Jun 5 and run acceptance tests Jun 9–11 so we can present preliminary findings on Jun 12 to the product team. Does that timeline work with your provisioning window?

Thanks,
Alex
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greencart.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, procurement@greencart.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange + MAP draft

Alex — quick answers and next actions: 

- Emergency takedown: Redwood will honor a 2-hour takedown SLA during active pilot hours (8am–6pm PT Mon–Fri). If you report a prompt/exposure, we will suspend the offending prompt, revoke keys tied to that dataset, and share redacted telemetry within the SLA window. This is documented in section 4.3 of the MAP.
- Procurement: PO is acceptable; DocuSign also works. I've added procurement@greencart.ai to the thread for any PO logistics.
- Timeline: Jun 5 ingestion → Jun 9–11 acceptance tests → Jun 13 close (contingent on passing gates) is doable. We will provision sandbox creds as soon as we have either the signed MAP or a brief email approval from procurement plus your engineering point-of-contact.

Attached: redlines_GC_eval_MAP.docx (we'll review once you send). I'll also open a short ticket for temporary token quota bump if you need it during acceptance test days — please confirm desired peak tokens.

If that all sounds good, please: (1) send the redline doc or sign the MAP, (2) upload the sanitized transcripts to the Drive folder, (3) confirm the list of 4 engineers who need sandbox access.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0789
